Fitting Room keeps skins here.

Each skin is a folder inside this one holding that skin's texture files. Anything
you put in shows up in the Skin section of the Overlays page the next time
Fitting Room scans.

The Overlays page can also fill this folder for you. It finds the whole-body skin
replacers you already have installed and offers to link them in. Those are hard
links, so a linked skin costs no extra disk space and your load order is left
alone.

Do not delete this folder. Fitting Room needs a real folder to put those links
in, and without one every link fails with "the skins folder could not be opened"
in the log.
